review_questions: Independently assess whether AUTO_MODE and MANUAL_MODE are separated from review authority semantics correctly.
Assess whether primary R1 may recommend review without being able to waive deterministic REQUIRED review.
Assess whether production MANUAL_MODE using USER_INITIATED_API preserves the same provider API and governance semantics as AUTO_MODE/AUTOMATIC_API.
Assess whether MANUAL_RELAY is safely limited to a fallback transport and cannot redesign or weaken production API review.
Assess whether CI-built self-contained review packets are sufficient for a reviewer with zero GitHub/repository/tool access and whether full-file packet integrity/revision binding fail closed.
Assess shared project memory continuity and authority separation across chat/session boundaries.

Identify any path by which proposer confidence, reviewer consensus, platform mode, user choice, transport behavior, shared memory, API failure, packet export, or chat-window changes could bypass mandatory evidence/review/governor gates.
Assess whether deterministic tests and CI are sufficient for this bounded candidate and identify missing adversarial cases.
Return an independent disposition without assuming or using the proposer conclusion.
